definitions.full: H7777. Shuw 'al II. שׁוּעָל proper name, of a location district in Israel ; — שׁ ׳אֶרֶץ 1Sam 13:17 ( עָפְרָה דֶּרֶךְ ); not identified. — See also שׁ ׳חֲצַר above III. שׁוּעָל proper name, masculine in Asher ; — 1Chr 7:36 , Σουλα , A Σουαλ , ᵐ5 L Σουαν .
